focus.title: 欧盟对华电动汽车反补贴税终裁落地，合规应对与供应链调整成焦点
focus.summary: 欧盟委员会于2026年11月12日公布对原产于中国的电动汽车反补贴调查终裁，决定征收为期五年的最终反补贴税。税率因企业配合程度而异，配合调查的企业税率较低，未配合企业面临较高税率。中国机电商会表示强烈不满，并已代表行业向欧盟普通法院提起诉讼。对于中国车企而言，需立即评估对欧出口成本，优化定价策略，同时考虑通过海外建厂、本地化采购等方式降低影响。此外，企业应关注欧盟外国补贴条例（FSR）在并购和公共采购领域的叠加适用风险。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会公告、中国机电产品进出口商会声明 · 2026.11.13
focus.title_en: EU Imposes Definitive Countervailing Duties on Chinese EVs: Compliance and Supply Chain Adjustments in Focus
focus.summary_en: The European Commission published its definitive countervailing duty findings on electric vehicles originating in China on 12 November 2026, imposing duties for five years. Rates vary based on the level of cooperation during the investigation, with cooperating companies receiving lower duties and non-cooperating companies facing higher rates. The China Chamber of Commerce for Import and Export of Machinery and Electronic Products (CCCME) has expressed strong opposition and filed a lawsuit with the General Court of the EU on behalf of the industry. Chinese automakers should immediately assess the cost impact on exports to Europe, refine pricing strategies, and consider overseas production and local procurement to mitigate effects. Companies should also monitor the cumulative application risks of the EU Foreign Subsidies Regulation (FSR) in M&A and public procurement.
focus.source_en: Source: European Commission announcement; CCCME statement · 2026.11.13

case.title: 新加坡上诉庭明确跨境数据披露令的域外效力，中资企业应关注数据出境合规
case.summary: 新加坡上诉庭于2026年10月就一起涉及中资背景公司的商业纠纷作出判决，首次明确新加坡法院签发的数据披露令可要求当事方披露存储于境外的数据，但需满足“与新加坡诉讼程序有实质联系”及“披露不违反数据所在国法律”两项条件。该案涉及一家在新加坡上市的中资企业，法院在平衡诉讼公正与数据本地化要求后，部分批准了披露申请。此案提示中国出海企业，在跨境诉讼中可能面临境外法院要求提供存储于中国境内的数据，企业需提前评估中国《数据安全法》《个人信息保护法》下的出境合规义务，并制定应对策略。
case.source: 来源：新加坡上诉庭判决摘要 · 2026.10
case.title_en: Singapore Appellate Court Clarifies Extraterritorial Effect of Cross-Border Data Disclosure Orders: Chinese Companies Should Focus on Data Export Compliance
case.summary_en: In October 2026, the Singapore Appellate Division ruled in a commercial dispute involving a China-backed company, clarifying for the first time that data disclosure orders issued by Singapore courts may require parties to disclose data stored overseas, subject to two conditions: a 'substantial connection to Singapore proceedings' and 'disclosure not violating the laws of the country where the data is located.' The case involved a Chinese company listed in Singapore, and the court partially granted the disclosure application after balancing litigation fairness and data localisation requirements. This case highlights that Chinese companies may face foreign court orders to produce data stored in China in cross-border litigation. Companies should proactively assess data export compliance obligations under China's Data Security Law and Personal Information Protection Law and develop response strategies.
case.source_en: Source: Singapore Appellate Division judgment summary · 2026.10

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境商事纠纷“一站式”解决平台上线，助力企业高效解纷
policy.summary: 2026年11月11日，粤港澳大湾区跨境商事纠纷“一站式”解决平台在广州正式上线。该平台由广东省高级人民法院、香港特区政府律政司、澳门特区政府行政法务司共同推动，整合了调解、仲裁、诉讼等多元化纠纷解决机制，为企业提供在线立案、跨境送达、证据交换、在线调解及仲裁等服务。平台还引入了香港、澳门调解机构和仲裁机构，支持当事人选择适用港澳法律或国际商事规则。对于大湾区内的出海企业，该平台可降低跨境解纷的时间与成本，建议企业在合同中约定利用该平台解决争议，并关注相关规则衔接。
policy.source: 来源：广东省高级人民法院、香港律政司、澳门行政法务司联合公告 · 2026.11.11
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Launches One-Stop Cross-Border Commercial Dispute Resolution Platform to Boost Efficient Dispute Resolution
policy.summary_en: On 11 November 2026, the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area one-stop cross-border commercial dispute resolution platform was officially launched in Guangzhou. Jointly promoted by the Guangdong High People's Court, the Hong Kong Department of Justice, and the Macao Administrative and Legal Affairs Bureau, the platform integrates mediation, arbitration, and litigation, offering online case filing, cross-border service, evidence exchange, online mediation, and arbitration services. It also incorporates Hong Kong and Macao mediation and arbitration institutions, allowing parties to choose the application of Hong Kong, Macao, or international commercial rules. For companies in the GBA, the platform can reduce the time and cost of cross-border dispute resolution. Companies are advised to consider incorporating the platform into their dispute resolution clauses and to monitor the alignment of relevant rules.
policy.source_en: Source: Joint announcement by Guangdong High People's Court, Hong Kong Department of Justice, and Macao Administrative and Legal Affairs Bureau · 2026.11.11

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对华投资限制新规扩围，企业应构建“投资+技术+数据”三维合规体系
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国财政部外国投资委员会（CFIUS）近期扩大了对华投资限制的领域范围，将人工智能、量子计算、生物技术等纳入重点关注清单，并强化了对合资企业和技术许可交易的审查。对于涉及美国资本或技术的中国出海企业，建议立即开展三项工作：第一，梳理现有及拟议交易中的美国连接点，评估是否触发CFIUS管辖；第二，建立技术出口管制分类台账，明确核心技术是否受美国出口管制条例（EAR）约束；第三，完善数据跨境流动合规机制，防范因数据问题引发的投资审查风险。同时，企业应关注中国《反外国制裁法》下的应对措施，必要时寻求专业法律意见。
analysis.source: 来源：秦林蒿律师团队实务观察 · 2026.11.13
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: Expanding US Outbound Investment Restrictions Require a Three-Dimensional Compliance Framework Covering Investment, Technology, and Data
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The US Treasury's Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States (CFIUS) has recently expanded the scope of investment restrictions related to China, adding artificial intelligence, quantum computing, and biotechnology to its priority list and strengthening scrutiny of joint ventures and technology licensing transactions. For Chinese companies with US capital or technology links, three immediate steps are recommended: first, map US nexus points in existing and proposed transactions to assess CFIUS jurisdiction; second, establish a technology export control classification register to determine whether core technologies are subject to the Export Administration Regulations (EAR); third, improve data cross-border transfer compliance mechanisms to mitigate investment review risks arising from data issues. Companies should also monitor countermeasures under China's Anti-Foreign Sanctions Law and seek professional legal advice when necessary.
analysis.source_en: Source: Practical observations by Attorney Qin Linhao's team · 2026.11.13
